images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: entirely NEW hover encounter illustration for a Dragon Database form card.
Primary request: create an original dragon individual from this text alone, with a specific distinct physical identity, pose and environment. This is a new illustration, not an edit, recoloring or restaging of any existing illustration.
Style/medium: sophisticated colorful painterly fantasy storybook art, finely painted scales and subtle ink-like detail, expressive mature creature design, textured gouache/watercolor brushwork, atmospheric layered epic scenery. No photorealism or 3D rendering.
Composition/framing: horizontal landscape 5:3, full-bleed. One mature powerful creature centrally dominant and immediately readable as a form-card subject. Crisp detailed silhouette, strong light/dark and warm/cool contrast against a softer painted epic setting. Keep its whole head, full continuous body, tail and all defining wings or fins comfortably inside the frame with breathing room for a shallow card crop. Do not let wing tips, horns or tail cross the frame. Keep background detail softer and lower-contrast than the creature.
Constraints: exactly one creature, exact anatomy specified below. No people or extra creatures, no text, lettering, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, interface, collage or gore. No fire or breath attacks. Respect the specific new identity and scene rather than substituting a generic spiky dragon.
Scene/backdrop: an ancient snow-covered pale stone bridge spanning a pale arctic valley, simple weathered masonry, distant blue-white snow peaks and a sky alive with soft MAGENTA and GREEN aurora. Soft cold atmosphere with luminous pale snow behind the saturated serpent.
Subject identity: a SLENDER COBALT/SAPPHIRE WYRM with a SILVER BELLY, small sleek polished blue scales, a smooth long narrow dragon head, and exactly two SHORT SPIRAL HORNS close to the head. Elegant streamlined neck and very little spiky armor. Absolutely NO legs, NO arms, NO hands, NO feet, NO wings and NO fins anywhere. One long continuous narrow serpentine body with a tapering tail, stretched in a taut broad S weaving across the snowy stone bridge, not a thick stationary pile of coils. Head faces LEFT, mouth CLOSED, eyes watchful and intelligent. The entire serpent is readable across the bridge foreground.
Distinctness requirements: blue/silver slender build, long smooth narrow muzzle, small spiral horns, left-facing watchfulness and an arctic bridge/aurora setting. No emerald body, bulky armored head, sweeping long horns or rose cavern.
Palette: crisp cobalt and sapphire scales, silver belly highlights, pale arctic whites and blue-gray stone, delicate magenta/green aurora.
